name: Genre Mapper
description: Maps the genres of the items to a list of genres chosen by the administrator, directly in the metadata: merge duplicates and translations (like "Adventure" and "Aventure"), rename or remove genres. Applied to the existing items, the new imports and the metadata refreshes, and the original genres can be restored at any time.
overview: Map the genres of your items to your own list of genres

versions.changelog: Genre list as wide as the settings page (up to 77em), final genre fields at least as wide as the removed genres title.
Wider settings page, final genres edited directly in a text field, genre columns aligned.

Settings page in two columns: the final genres on the left (rename to merge, delete, add) and the original genres moved into them on the right. The mapping is always applied to the original genres of the items, so changing it never stacks on the previous one.
Single genre list (keep, rename, merge or remove each genre), merge suggestions removed, official genre lists limited to the metadata fetchers enabled in the libraries.
